locator.section: Rubricae generales 28,31a,35; Rubricae generales Missalis Romani 475–476, especially 476e

uses.claim: RG 28,31a and 35 distinguish the second-class Ascension Vigil from a feast. RGM 475 does not include this weekday Vigil among the Masses requiring the Creed, and 476e excludes a commemoration as an independent reason to add it. Together these rules support omission of the Creed in the temporal weekday Ascension Vigil Mass. They do not prescribe a Sunday or votive use or determine the Mass selected when a higher-ranking feast prevents the Vigil.
uses.decision_reason: Vatican RG 28, 31a, 35 distinguish this preparatory second-class Vigil from its feast; RGM 475 does not include this weekday temporal Vigil in the positive Creed list, and 476e does not add it merely for a commemoration.
